$comment: Templated rival encounter (docs/willy/DESIGN.md §17): the same tree for every procedural or legendary rival. Text starting with "$partnerTag:" is resolved by the client from a tag of whoever Willy is talking to (content/willy/gen/rivals.ts sets dlg-inicio/dlg-amenaza/dlg-pacto/dlg-huida/dlg-derrota on the entity when it's generated, so the line matches that exact rival's race, personality and mania). Speaker "$partner" resolves the same way to the rival's entity. The Pactar DC reads the rival's own "pacto:<n>" tag (comportamiento's pactoDif, or a legendary's fixed one). Tagged on the rival room's entity as dialogue:rivalEncuentro (content/willy/gen/floor.ts); rulesets/willy's rivalAfterCommand hook records the outcome in systems.rivals and fires the Narrador.
